_comment: Bundle budgets for the Mochiichao web build. Single source of truth for tests/check-bundle-budget.mjs and docs/ci-budgets-2026-10-27.md. Baselines measured 2026-10-27: (a) live gh-pages single bundle index-r-Trvo3i.js = 2,266,589 bytes raw, 518,474 bytes gzip (curl); (b) full local production build dist/ = 1,465 JS files, 2,969,102 bytes raw, 976,249 bytes gzip (vite build --base=./ from main 08648398). The single-bundle numbers and the dist totals are different scopes — budgets cover both. Tightening a budget is a Mars decision, not a silent edit. RAISED 2026-10-29 (Mars decision: 'Raise the budgets', no bundle diet): this setup was rebuilt after the 2026-10-28 repo recreation (old PR #282 did not come back). Re-measured on current main da313e3: dist = 223 JS files, largest chunk 2,433,670 raw / 613,522 gzip, total JS 2,828,385 raw / 785,210 gzip — the old overrun (2,620,499 largest / 3,323,012 total, measured 2026-10-27 against a 1,465-JS-file dist) no longer occurs on current main, whose dist structure changed. New budgets: largest raw raised to 2,700,000 (measured +~11%), total raw raised to 3,650,000 (the 2026-10-27 overrun figure +~10%, per the raise decision); the two gzip budgets already carried >10% headroom over today's measurements and are unchanged. No budget was tightened. See docs/ci-budgets-raised-2026-10-29.md.
